description: Verifies the critic's claim that run_B IS sweep-L49 (same raw-dot scoring), and run_A correlates maximally with sweep-L43 rather than sweep-L49 — which means the two-cluster depth structure is real within raw-dot scoring but the 0/10 run_A/run_B top-10 overlap at L49 is a scoring-method effect, not a depth-boundary effect.
interpretation: run_B has rho=1.0 with sweep-L49 (confirming same raw-dot scoring convention). run_A has max correlation 0.7296 with sweep-L43, not with sweep-L49 (rho=0.4648) where it was nominally measured. The two-cluster depth structure (L37-L43 contentment vs L49-L67 activation) is entirely within raw-dot scoring. The 0/10 top-10 overlap between run_A and run_B at L49 is a scoring-method effect (canonical normalized vs raw dot produce different emotion rankings at the same layer), NOT a cluster-boundary resolution effect as the draft's earlier causal story claimed. Canonical scoring at L49 happens to resemble raw-dot at L43 more than raw-dot at L49, which is interesting but doesn't directly prove 'L49 is at a boundary'.
